Greedy farthest-reach. O(n).

For jump game can reach I will track the farthest reachable index as I iterate.

```python
def can_jump(nums):
    reach = 0
    for i, n in enumerate(nums):
        if i > reach: return False
        reach = max(reach, i + n)
    return True
```
